## 🛡️ Wiz Security Finding Details

| Attribute | Value |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Title** | `SQL Injection in Query Constructor` |
| **Severity** | `HIGH` |
| **CWE** | `CWE-89` |
| **File Path** | `src/auth/session_manager.py` |
| **Line Number** | `42` |
| **Wiz Console Link** | [View in Wiz Console](https://app.wiz.io/findings/FINDING_ID_HERE) |

---

### Description
Raw user input from request headers is directly concatenated into a dynamic SQL query without parameterization or proper sanitization. This permits arbitrary SQL execution.

---

### Wiz Green Agent Analysis
The Green Agent has verified that the vulnerable parameter `session_token` flows directly into `cursor.execute("SELECT ... WHERE token = '" + session_token + "'")`.
- **Exploitability**: Confirmed exploitable in unit tests.
- **Recommended Remediation**: Refactor the database query to use parameterized queries (`cursor.execute("SELECT ... WHERE token = %s", (session_token,))`) or utilize an ORM model query.

---
